package.name: prm_multigoal_planner
package.description: Action server (parallel_multigoal_planner_msgs/ParallelMultigoalPlan) that plans a motion reaching any one of several alternative Cartesian/joint-space goals with a persistent multi-goal Lazy PRM* (OMPL). The roadmap is reused across requests and rebuilt only when the planning scene (fetched from move_group before every request) changes. Planning stops as soon as cost < (1 + utopia_tolerance) * utopia, utopia = min_i ||goal_i - start||.
